verses.english: “For insight into greed, four things should be developed.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti;
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to enthusiasm, and active effort.
They develop the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to energy …

verses.pali: Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these four things should be developed.”
